contexts.text: They desired to return to their domestic affairs; some to their functions; some to their businesses; and some to their works.
All are intent on performing the duties of their offices.

That in the Lord there are two functions, the priestly and the royal... From His priestly function He is called Jesus, and from His royal function, Christ... As to Redemption, it pertains to both functions.

As they believed that they were worthy... functions were given them... but because they were of such a character they were cast out of their functions, and were allowed... to procure functions for themselves.
By which they perform their works, functions, and exercises.
The goods which do not flow from their functions they do not call uses, but alms...
5. 3. The functions of their offices in like manner differ from the... functions of natural men in the world, which cannot be described...
